name: lwg-trading-devtools
description: Repo-root dev tooling ONLY — formatting, linting, and the pre-commit runner. This is NOT an application package: nothing here is imported by any app, and `command-center/frontend` keeps its own package.json for the actual React build. It lives at the root because lint-staged has to see EVERY staged path (python included), and a tool rooted inside one subsystem cannot.
